title: Irrigation backflow installation: start with the approved protection method
description: Irrigation installation begins with the local protection requirement and actual irrigation connection.
prompt: What must be approved before installing irrigation backflow protection?
answer: Irrigation installation begins with the local protection requirement and actual irrigation connection. Device selection, elevation, access, freeze exposure, testability, and initial filing must be confirmed before a contractor price becomes comparable.
urgency: Escalate uncertain utility requirements, hidden connections, freeze-exposed placement, or missing initial-test responsibility.
identifiers: The utility or authority establishes the required protection method.
Location must allow required access, service, and testing.
Winter exposure and irrigation shutdown practice affect installation planning.
